llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.support
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.support.runtime
role Supply injectable clock, process identity, randomness, sleep, environment, and liveness probes for deterministic tests.
owns runtime injection, deterministic identity, process liveness, deadline scheduling
excludes filesystem access, generation policy

@llmnav.support.abort
role Expose cooperative cancellation checks so long scans, queries, and generations can stop at bounded checkpoints.
owns abort checks, abort error normalization
excludes cancellation sources, retry policy

@llmnav.support.policy
role Keep named policies for search ranking, audit prioritization, source limits, declaration scanning, and context sizing.
owns search ranking weights, search input limits, audit scoring, source byte limits, declaration scan limits, token estimates
excludes query execution, configuration loading, agent transport
rel workflow>llmnav.search.query, workflow>llmnav.agent.tool-schema, workflow>llmnav.audit.coverage

@llmnav.support.errors
role Describe failures with a stable code, retry classification, cause chain, and bounded operation deadline.
owns error codes, cause chains, retry classification, operation deadlines
excludes diagnostics reporting, CLI formatting, retry scheduling
invariant Every wrapped failure keeps the original error as its cause.

@llmnav.support.concurrency
role Run independent filesystem work with a bounded number of in-flight tasks while keeping results ordered.
owns bounded asynchronous map, deterministic failure selection, concurrency limit validation
excludes retry policy, thread pools, request scheduling
invariant Results keep input order and the lowest failing index is reported regardless of completion order.

@llmnav.support.read-operation
role Bound idempotent reads with cooperative cancellation and opt-in transient retries.
owns read deadlines, read retry scheduling, retry jitter
excludes write retries, transaction recovery, shared cache ownership
invariant Cancellation and deadline failures never start another attempt.
